description: This file defines a Java interface 'DistributedDataConfig' that provides configuration settings for distributed data operations, including methods for retrieving read and write timeouts, as well as the Akka replicator configuration. It also contains an enum 'DistributedDataConfigValue' defining known config paths and default values for timeout settings.

classes.name: DistributedDataConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration accessors for distributed data handling, including read/write timeouts and Akka replicator configuration.

methods.name: getReadTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for GET messages of the replicator.

methods.name: getWriteTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for UPDATE messages of the replicator.

methods.name: getAkkaReplicatorConfig
methods.description: Returns the Akka replicator configuration used for distributed data.

inner_classes.name: DistributedDataConfigValue
inner_classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for DistributedDataConfig, implementing KnownConfigValue.

constants.name: READ_TIMEOUT
constants.description: Timeout duration for GET messages; default is 5 seconds.

constants.name: WRITE_TIMEOUT
constants.description: Timeout duration for UPDATE messages; default is 25 seconds.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with the config.
